question: What was the population standard deviation of federal U.S. Government net outlays by function for the months in CY1981 in millions of nominal dollars (rounded to the nearest hundredths place)?
raw_response:
The 12 calendar-year 1981 monthly Net budget outlays (Jan–Dec 1981, in millions) are: 59099, 53969, 54216, 57198, 54608, 55619, 58486, 53095, 53698, 64216, 56838, 76875.

Population standard deviation = 6379.29 million dollars.

<FINAL_ANSWER>6379.29</FINAL_ANSWER>
